Omits the dual-format distribution model, the local-first architecture of the installed MCP servers, and the specific set of skills that do require internet (web-research skills only).

transfer_problems: A learner is on a flight with no wifi and wants to run a Tier 0 learning skill using a pre-built corpus. Will it work, and why or why not, given how surreal-memory and sycophancy-correction are deployed?

Explain why running pmpo-elicit or learn-goal's corpus assembly step would fail offline, while invoking the sycophancy-correction MCP server to check a draft grade would not, referencing where each service actually runs.
